notes: Receipts now print at 58mm, the size of the shop's roll. They were laid out for 80mm paper, which is about a third too wide.
A line sold by the kilo now prints "kilo" on the receipt instead of the bag it came out of.
Quantities can be changed on the order itself, beside the total, instead of only on the product.
Typing a quantity larger than the shelf now says what it would leave, the way the delivery screen already did.
Future updates clean up files a new version no longer uses, which is what stopped the last update from installing.
